definitions.inside_predicted: native estimate inside the 95% interval of the predicted cell
definitions.discriminating: inside the predicted cell's interval, outside the other label's
definitions.label_circular: comparisons on the branches B is inferred from (circular_branches)
definitions.chance_coverage: share of the four label cells' 95% intervals that contain the native estimate, i.e. the coverage when the label is permuted
definitions.inflated: interval half-widths widened in quadrature by 1.96 x the standard error from the repeat-ingestion variance

discriminability.rule: a comparison discriminates when the native estimate is inside the predicted cell's 95% interval and outside that of the other B label's cell (same D)
